reviews.title: Doesn’t do what I want
reviews.text: I paid the 39.99 for one year, then paid 9.99 to use the app. I tried 3 times to edit a photo which charged 24 in app tokens which I assume will require the purchase of more when my initial 1000 run out. All three edit attempts failed with an ‘oops, something went wrong’ message and a prompt to try again. I didn’t get the 72 tokens returned for the three failed attempts. I only tried one prompt at a time but I assume if I wanted to add more prompts it would have cost more tokens for each separate prompt. I expected to get some use out of this app which is why I opted for full year instead of weekly trial. I would strongly suggest that new users opt for weekly trial before committing fully. After approximately 10 minutes I’ve learned enough to cancel my subscription for the second year and delete the app from my phone. ChatAPT is easier to use and offers better results for free.

reviews.title: Privacy concern
reviews.text:
I have a privacy concern about a this image generator. It was my first time using the app, and I only uploaded a photo that showed my face. However, when it generated an image of me, it also reproduced a small black dot in the exact location on my arm/forearm where I have one even though that part of my body was not visible in the photo I uploaded.

How could the generator know about such a specific detail if it only had access to my face photo? Does the app have access to other photos in my phone’s gallery, or could it have accessed my photos without me realizing it? I’m concerned about whether my private photos and personal information are being accessed or used without my knowledge.

reviews.title: Each “update” takes away more of the things that made this app great. GO FIND ANOTHER
reviews.text:
I’ve had this app for years and it used to be super fun. You could play around with different ideas and tweak them in real time to experiment with styles, keywords etc. But each time they brag about a “major update to resolve issues”, they are putting more and more of the things that made this app a 4 or 5 star product and either delete them entirely or hide them behind the recent “token” paywall. Even for users that paid for weekly and then “all inclusive” subscriptions. 

You want to make good stuff like you used to? That will cost a couple tokens. Remember that feature and filters you used to love and use all the time? Those are gone now but we replaced them with “better ones” but behind another token paywall. 

Oh and it crashes ALL of the TIME now. Each request crashes the app and requires 3-5 reboots. 

And they ask every bad review to reach out to the company. I’ve done that too. Multiple times. They take weeks if not months to respond. Then simply say “we don’t do that anymore.”

Even like 6 months ago, this was a great app. Now save yourself the trouble and find another.

It almost feels like the AI is programmed to do that purposely to keep charging you credits which you have to purchase when they run out, even with a subscription. This AI app charges you $10 weekly or $40 a year. I’m hesitant to pay the $40 if I’m gonna have to keep purchasing tokens just to simply edit photos then endlessly re edit pictures that the AI keeps flipping back & forth, and also to utilize about 90% of what they offer. This particular AI could be a money pit. I gave it two star and it was all I could do to keep from giving it one star because it is so frustrating going back-and-forth trying to do, then redo, then redo, then redo what it just did, then un did, then did again and un did again. It does generate some pretty nice images and the image quality is pretty nice, that’s the only reason I gave it 2 star instead of one.
